title: Attention Is All You Need
abstract: Introduces the Transformer architecture based entirely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions. Achieves state-of-the-art on NLP tasks.

title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
abstract: Presents residual learning framework to ease training of very deep neural networks. Introduces skip connections to prevent vanishing gradients.

title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers
abstract: Introduces BERT, a method for pre-training language representations using a deep bidirectional transformer encoder. Achieves SOTA on 11 NLP tasks.

title: Playing Atari with Deep Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Presents first deep learning model to successfully learn control policies from raw pixel input using RL. Introduces Deep Q-Network (DQN).

title: Random Forests
abstract: Introduces Random Forest algorithm combining multiple decision trees. Shows improvements in accuracy and robustness over single-tree methods.

title: A Survey on Transfer Learning
abstract: Comprehensive survey of transfer learning techniques. Categorizes approaches and identifies key challenges in transferring knowledge across domains.

title: The PageRank Citation Ranking
abstract: Describes the PageRank algorithm that forms the basis of Google Search. Models the web as a directed graph and ranks pages by importance.

title: Generative Adversarial Networks
abstract: Introduces GANs — two competing neural networks (generator and discriminator) that learn to produce realistic synthetic data.

title: Long Short-Term Memory
abstract: Introduces LSTM cells that solve the vanishing gradient problem in RNNs. Enables learning long-range dependencies in sequences.

title: XGBoost: A Scalable Tree Boosting System
abstract: Presents XGBoost, an efficient and scalable implementation of gradient boosting. Widely used in ML competitions and industry.

title: An Introduction to Bioinformatics Algorithms
abstract: Foundational textbook covering algorithms for biological sequence analysis including dynamic programming and graph-based methods.

title: Ethereum: A Next-Generation Smart Contract Platform
abstract: Introduces Ethereum as a programmable blockchain platform with Turing-complete smart contract capability.

title: MapReduce: Simplified Data Processing on Large Clusters
abstract: Introduces MapReduce programming model for processing large datasets across clusters of machines. Foundation for Hadoop ecosystem.

title: Proximal Policy Optimization Algorithms
abstract: Presents PPO, a simple and effective policy gradient algorithm for RL. Balances ease of implementation with sample efficiency.

title: A Tutorial on Support Vector Machines
abstract: Accessible introduction to SVMs including geometric intuition, kernel trick, and optimization formulation.

title: Deep Learning for Natural Language Processing
abstract: Comprehensive primer on applying deep learning to NLP tasks. Covers word2vec, RNNs, CNNs, and attention for text.

title: Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space
abstract: Introduces Word2Vec models (Skip-gram, CBOW) for learning distributed word representations from large corpora.

title: U-Net: Convolutional Networks for Biomedical Image Segmentation
abstract: Presents U-Net architecture for semantic segmentation with limited training data. Widely adopted in medical imaging.

title: Variational Autoencoders
abstract: Introduces variational autoencoder framework combining variational inference with deep learning for generative modeling.

title: An Introduction to Statistical Learning
abstract: Accessible introduction to statistical learning methods including regression, classification, resampling, and tree methods.

title: Mastering the Game of Go with Deep Neural Networks
abstract: Describes AlphaGo, which combined deep neural networks with Monte Carlo tree search to defeat world champion Go players.

title: The Anatomy of a Large-Scale Hypertextual Web Search Engine
abstract: Original Google paper describing architecture of a large-scale web search engine. Foundational for information retrieval.

title: SMILES-Based Molecular Generation Using Transformers
abstract: Survey of transformer-based approaches for generating novel drug-like molecules using SMILES string representations.

title: Kubernetes: Up and Running
abstract: Practical guide to deploying containerized applications with Kubernetes. Covers pods, services, deployments and scaling.

title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
abstract: Covers fundamental concepts behind reliable, scalable, and maintainable data systems including databases, streams, and batch processing.
